Discovery Bay, Jamaica (1966 to 1968)

Jamaica
Discovery Bay
1960s
A set of underwater photographs from Discovery Bay, Jamaica (1966 to 1968), taken by Eileen Graham. The photographs capture the north coast reefs in a state of vibrancy now largely lost.

collectionID: 10.5281/zenodo.22663465 | collectionName: The Eileen Graham Collection (Discovery Bay, Jamaica, 1966 to 1968). | license: http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode | rightsHolder: Trustees of the Natural History Museum
